options.name: Pyromancer
options.desc: Your fire damage ignores resistance from nonmagical sources (mundane armor, wet cloth, mundane stone).

options.name: Hearth-Keeper
options.desc: You and allies within 10 ft. of you have resistance to cold damage and ignore non-extreme cold environments.

options.name: Emberkin
options.desc: When you take fire damage, you may roll a d6; on a 4+, you take no damage and gain 5 temp HP. Once per round.

options.name: Inferno-Touched
options.desc: When you take fire damage, regain MP equal to half the damage taken (rounded down). Once per round.

options.name: Cinderborn
options.desc: Your fire spells deal +1 die of damage, and creatures killed by your fire leave behind embers that deal 1d6 fire to anyone entering the space for 1 minute.

options.name: Death-Bound
options.desc: You have advantage on saves against being frightened or charmed. Once per long rest, when you would drop to 0 HP, you may drop to 1 instead.

options.name: Grave-Walker
options.desc: You can move through spaces occupied by hostile undead as though they were difficult terrain, and take no opportunity attacks from them.

options.name: Death-Knell
options.desc: When a creature within 30 ft. of you drops to 0 HP, you regain HP equal to your prof bonus (once per turn).

options.name: The Devouring Dark
options.desc: Creatures slain by you rise as wraiths under your command for 1 minute (max 1 wraith at a time).

options.name: Soul-Harvester
options.desc: When a creature within 30 ft. of you dies, you may regain MP equal to half its CR (rounded up, min 1). Once per round.

options.name: Wind-Walker
options.desc: You may take the Dash action as a bonus action; opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage.

options.name: Storm-Called
options.desc: You have resistance to thunder and lightning damage; ranged attacks against you have disadvantage in open air.

options.name: Tide-Song
options.desc: Your healing effects restore an additional 1d4 HP and may also remove one minor condition (DM discretion).

options.name: Deep-Well
options.desc: Once per short rest, restore 5 MP as a bonus action by drawing on your inner tide.
